Marshall & Dominguez LLP
Pearland, TX

Letter of Representation
April 14, 2025
Claims Department
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Re: Claim C-1440
Our client: Tonya Compton
Date of loss: March 31, 2025
Dear Claims Representative:
This firm represents the individual injured in the rear-end collision described in the enclosed materials, and all further
communication concerning this matter should be directed to our office rather than to our client. Please do not contact
our client directly by telephone, mail, or in person, and route any requests for statements, recorded interviews, or
authorizations through this firm.
Our client sustained injuries that required medical treatment and continue to affect daily activities. We are gathering
the documentation needed to present a full claim, and we will provide it once treatment and records are complete.
To assist in evaluating this matter, please provide a certified copy of the declarations page and the full policy limits for
bodily injury and property damage coverage applicable to the at-fault driver, along with confirmation of any excess or
umbrella coverage that may apply.
Please also take immediate steps to preserve all evidence relating to this loss. This includes vehicle data and
telematics, photographs, dash camera footage, recorded statements, adjutser notes, claim file materials, repair
estimates, and any communications with the insured or third parties. Routine deletion or destruction of such materials
should be suspended until this matter is resolved.
Sincerely,
Nina Stewart
Marshall & Dominguez LLP
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
